token.label: Max Token
token.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate in the chat completion. The total length of input tokens and generated tokens is limited by the model's context length.

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.description: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic. We generally recommend altering this or top p but not both. (Default: 1)

presencePenalty.label: Presence Penalty
presencePenalty.description: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics. (Default: 0)

topP.label: Top-p
topP.description: Number between 0 and 1. An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered. We generally recommend altering this or temperature but not both. (Default: 1)

frequencyPenalty.label: Frequency Penalty
frequencyPenalty.description: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim. (Default: 0)

provider.title: AI Provider Settings
provider.apiKeyRequired: Enter an API key to fetch the model list

fusion.costWarning: Fusion runs a multi-model panel plus a judge on top of your request — expect roughly 4–5× the cost of a single completion.

presets.label: Presets
presets.replaceConfirm: Replace the current system prompt with this preset?

openRouter.scope: Settings for the selected model. Switching models restores that model’s settings.
openRouter.defaultScope: Settings for the selected model, copied to new chats.
openRouter.slugHelp: Add providers from the list or enter comma-separated slugs, including region and variant slugs. The list includes all providers and does not guarantee support for this model. Explicit order takes precedence over sticky routing.
openRouter.zdrHelp: Require ZDR providers and disable response caching where cache controls are supported. Saved cache settings are retained on direct connections. Local history and proxy recovery storage are separate; account restrictions still apply.
openRouter.cacheUnknown: Claude caching is requested; endpoint support and actual cache hits remain unverified.
openRouter.cacheUnsupported: Explicit input caching is unavailable for this model. Provider-managed automatic caching may still apply.
openRouter.responseHelp: Identical requests may return the same answer. Regeneration refreshes the cache when caching is on; inherited settings remain inherited. Server presets can disable caching.
openRouter.stickySession: Use a chat-specific session for routing
openRouter.constraintsHelp: Allowed/excluded providers, price ceilings and data restrictions also apply when sending this chat’s content for titles or external evaluation. Incompatible auxiliary requests are blocked.

errors.conflict: Provider order, allowlist and exclusions conflict.
errors.price: Price ceilings must be finite numbers greater than or equal to zero.
errors.ttl: Cache lifetime must be an integer from 1 to 86400 seconds.
errors.zdr: ZDR requires response caching to be explicitly off.
errors.model: This input cache mode requires a Claude model on OpenRouter.
errors.system: The submitted context contains no system text to cache.
errors.endpoint: OpenRouter controls require a verified OpenRouter API endpoint.
errors.auxiliary: This auxiliary request cannot enforce the chat’s OpenRouter restrictions.
errors.safety: External safety evaluation cannot enforce these OpenRouter restrictions. Change the evaluation or routing settings before submitting.

openRouter.providerLoadError: Could not load providers. You can still enter slugs manually.
openRouter.requireParametersHelp: Use this during validation when unsupported generation settings should cause a detectable failure. Only providers supporting every sent parameter are eligible; the request fails if none qualify. For ordinary chats, leave this on “Use OpenRouter settings”.

help.selection: Select automatic routing or sort providers by price, throughput, or latency.
help.allow_fallbacks: Allow another eligible provider when the preferred one is unavailable. Inherit uses OpenRouter settings.
help.promptPrice: Maximum input price in USD per million tokens. Empty means no request-level limit; 0 permits free input only.
help.completionPrice: Maximum output price in USD per million tokens. Empty means no request-level limit; 0 permits free output only.
help.data_collection: Exclude providers that may retain data, or inherit the OpenRouter account policy. Account restrictions still apply.
help.promptTTL: Requested Claude input-cache lifetime. Availability and actual cache hits depend on the endpoint.
help.responseTTL: Requested response-cache lifetime in seconds (1–86400). Empty uses 300 seconds.
help.stickySession: Use the chat ID as the routing session ID to encourage reuse of the same provider. This does not store chat history remotely.

openRouter.directCacheDisabled: Disabled for direct connections because response-cache control headers are blocked. Saved values are retained but not sent. They become available again through the Proxy.
openRouter.zdrCacheDisabled: Response caching is sent as off while ZDR is enabled.
